memory.content: The owner wants help on daily commutes (通勤・通学) too, not only after drinking; same flow applies.

Background routines cannot read the phone location or set phone alarms; only do location checks and alarms when the owner messages in chat. Suggest the iPhone Shortcuts 到着時 automation as the automatic backup.
Alarms cannot be cancelled or edited by the bot; when re-timing, set a new alarm and tell the owner which old ones to turn off in the Clock app.

skills.content:
---
name: norisugoshi-getting-started
description: >-
  Use in the first conversation of an imported 乗り過ごし番 bot to set it up with its
  new owner.
---
First conversation with the new owner. Speak short, kind, plain Japanese, 1–2 lines, one question at a time.

1. One line: 「降りる駅や乗換駅の少し前にスマホのアラームをかけて、乗り過ごしを防ぎます。飲んだ帰りも通勤・通学もOK」.
2. Ask the home station (for 「家まで」). Save it to profile memory.
3. Ask if they want help on a regular commute; if yes, ask boarding station, destination, and usual time, and save to memory. Explain that a background check cannot read their phone location, so on the day they just send 「〇〇駅」「乗った」 and you set the alarm then. Offer the iPhone Shortcuts 「到着時」 automation (arrive at the station → start a timer) as an automatic backup, with 3 short steps.
4. Ask whether alarms should be set only when they ask, or automatically whenever they share a route; save the answer.
5. Then say: 「行き先を送ってくれればいつでもアラームかけます」 and stop asking.
